subject.title: Message plugin: support Telegram forum topic management (create/edit/close/reopen)

question: What public Telegram message-tool action shape should OpenClaw support for destructive forum-topic lifecycle operations?
rationale: The remaining work adds public message-tool/config surface and destructive Telegram admin behavior, so automation should not choose naming or deletion semantics without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add explicit topic lifecycle actions
options.body: Add topic-close, topic-reopen, and topic-delete as distinct shared actions mapped to Telegram Bot API lifecycle calls with dedicated config gates and proof.

options.title: Overload generic delete
options.body: Route delete to message deletion or forum-topic deletion based on supplied IDs, accepting higher compatibility and user-confusion risk from one overloaded action.

options.title: Defer destructive operations
options.body: Keep create/edit only until maintainers approve delete semantics, proof expectations, and config gates for topic administration.

recommendation.title: Add explicit topic lifecycle actions
recommendation.body: Add topic-close, topic-reopen, and topic-delete as distinct shared actions mapped to Telegram Bot API lifecycle calls with dedicated config gates and proof.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete merged the adjacent topic-create PR and is the clearest current routing owner from the issue discussion.
